result.rationale: The diff shows totalPages = Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With user_count=50 and limit=50 this yields 2 pages instead of 1, so showingLast is false on the real last page; the 'next' action sets offset = min(offset+limit, user_count) = 50, fetching an empty member list. Mechanism fully verifiable in the diff.

judged_text: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1, which reports one page too many whenever user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50 members renders '1/2' instead of '1/1'). On any group whose member count is an exact multiple of 50, 'next' stays enabled on the last real page; clicking it fetches offset=user_count and renders a completely empty member list as if it were a valid page.
